title: personal-kpi-weekly-checkin-maya-singh-2026-03-03
content:
Weekly KPI / Goal check-in -- Maya Singh (Wk of 2026-03-03)

Quick summary:
- Focus this week: push rollout of kv-cache hotfix, finish eval comparison for q8 quantized variant, and validate Dedicated autoscaler changes in staging.
- Status: making steady progress on KR1/KR2, KR3 slipping due to infra flakiness on staging nodes.

OKRs (personal alignment to eng-serving-runtime OKRs)
- O: Improve serving reliability and reduce tail latency for text-generation endpoints.
  - KR1: 95th percentile latency for short-chat (<=128 tokens) <= 90ms on p3-equivalent.
    - Baseline (2026-01-01): 120ms 95p
    - Current: 98ms 95p (measured 2026-03-02) -- ~55% toward target if progress linear.
    - This week: deployed kv-cache hotfix to canary; 95p dropped from 104ms -> 98ms on canary. Need wider canary to validate.
    - Blockers: intermittent OOMs in canary under synthetic load (suspect memory leak in cache eviction path).
  - KR2: Reduce per-request token cost by 12% via batching + quantized model suggestions.
    - Baseline: $0.012/token (hosted avg)
    - Current: $0.0108/token (~10% reduction) -- on track but short of 12% target.
    - This week: completed eval harness for q8_2 and ran quality regression on 10 curated prompts. Q8_2 shows avg 0.5% nll increase, no major quality regressions in safety/QA.
    - Next: present recommendation for q8_2 for lower-cost tiers next Tue.
- O: Improve dev experience for model rollouts (personal KR - supporting product team)
  - KR3: Implement rollout canary + automatic fallback for 3rd-party model variants in Console.
    - Progress: feature PR merged (reviewed by product) but integration tests failing in staging.
    - Blockers: autoscaler behavior in Dedicated staging causes pods to spin up/terminate during integration tests (flaky). Tracking with infra (JIRA-RELAY-88).

This week -- accomplishments
- Merged kv-cache hotfix to canary and started 2-day canary run (logs + perf dashboards wired).
- Finished evaluation suite for q8_2 and drafted recommendation doc for product (link in linked_artifacts).
- Wrote test harness to simulate prefix-cache reuse across multi-tenant batches (found 2 edge cases).
- Paired with Samira to repro autoscaler flake and narrowed down to health-check signal threshold mismatch.

Blockers / Risks
- Staging flakiness (autoscaler + Dedicated staging infra) is delaying rollout of canary to prod. Infra team said prioritized but ETA unclear. If not resolved this week, KR3 will slip another sprint.
- Memory leak suspected in kv-cache eviction path -- need heap dump analysis. I can run jmap on canary if SRE approves (requires low-traffic window).

Next week -- plan / to-dos
- Priority 1: heap dump + root cause for OOM in kv-cache. (Action: schedule with SRE, target Mon AM).
- Priority 2: expand canary to 20% traffic if no OOM; monitor 95p and error budget.
- Priority 3: finalize q8_2 recommendation and present to product + finance (Tues lunchtime sync).
- Priority 4: stabilization plan for rollout feature tests (add mocks for autoscaler) and re-run integration suite.

Personal notes / scratchpad items
- Quick checklist for heap dump run:
  - Get SRE approval for jmap + low-traffic window (ask @Avery Chen).
  - Add extra logging around eviction path (metrics: eviction_count, avg_evicted_size).
  - Ensure canary retains 1 replica with debug image to reproduce OOM locally.
- Questions for product:
  - For q8_2 rollout, which customer segments get fallback to fp16 when quality regression > 1%? (cc: @Product-Hosted-API)
  - Should we show per-model-cost delta in Console rollout UI or keep it in Optimize suggestions only?

Meeting notes snippets (for copy into confluence later)
- 2026-03-02 sync with infra: infra will repro autoscaler flake with our test harness; tentative ETA for fix is Thu 2026-03-05.
- 2026-03-03 design review w/ product: product wants a conservative canary policy (start 5% -> 20% -> 50%) and explicit automatic fallback rule if error-rate > 0.5% for 10m.

Other reminders
- Add the q8_2 eval artifacts to the perf-benchmarks bucket and tag with commit sha.
- Follow up on Confluence doc CONFLUENCE-1234 (rollout playbook) to add our fallback examples.

Status tags (for my tracking):
- at_risk: KR3 (integration tests + staging infra)
- on_track: KR1 (so far)
- needs_review: q8_2 recommendation doc

Notes to self (quick):
- Keep communication tight with infra this week. If staging not fixed by Wed EOD, propose fallback: deploy rollout UI changes behind feature flag to prod but block auto-rollout until tests pass.
- When in doubt, revert canary to previous cache config and re-run tests (we have snapshot from 2026-02-20).

-- Maya
